selection_history: Added after inspection of historical focal results and omissions in 190-native-v2; exploratory sensitivity, not preregistration or independent validation.
declared_panel: 190-native-v2 remains unchanged; this is a separately named sidecar.

joint_exclusions.reason: Declared joint sensitivity for the historically observed cellulose carriers; run in every scope, including zero-support scopes, without effect-based selection.

selection_rule: Within each scope, focal trait, direction and rank, use the declared contributing_universe population before zero-total-pair exclusions. Rank resolved lineages with at least three supporting studies by descending propagated annotation count contribution, then taxon ID. Select the first three; take their union separately for each scope, alongside the fixed joint exclusions. Retain all candidate rankings and unresolved contributions. No p-value or effect selection.
eligibility: Paired human 16S/WMS profiles in the verified core; drop the whole pair when either retained non-MediaDive annotation total is zero. After a lineage removal, re-evaluate this same rule and report lost pairs and matched-support effects.
lineage_removal: Subtract the union of the excluded lineages' source-taxon contributions from every reported ancestor across the full retained denominator, counting a source only once even with multiple ancestry paths. Retain and flag ambiguous direct assertions above the excluded lineages.
study_loso: Omit every experiment of one study at a time. Recompute all six study sign tests and their complete six-member BH and BY families for each omission, separately by scope. Report the declared shared_fraction full-data baseline and BH-six beside every omission, with BY-six as an additional sensitivity. No other trait's full-data p-value is held fixed.
fraction: trait annotation count divided by the full retained annotation-count total, increased minus decreased; equal experiment weight within study and equal study weight.
ties: Absolute study mean no greater than 1e-12 is tied and excluded from the exact two-sided sign test.
multiplicity: BH-six and BY-six are conditional diagnostic values per scope/removal, not selected-trait, across-scenario or full-screen error control. Keep untestable members in family size with internal p=1 and undefined exported p/q.
interpretation: Changes in alignment between reported taxon directions and trait annotations; no physiological, causal, clinical or independent-replication claim. Search across lineages and LOSO omissions is descriptive.
